      "content": "\"\"\"Initial ticket query tool: listing and owner filtering only.\"\"\"\nimport argparse\nimport json\n\n\nTICKETS = [\n    {\"id\": 4, \"title\": \"Broken link\", \"owner\": \"bob\", \"status\": \"open\"},\n    {\"id\": 1, \"title\": \"Login error\", \"owner\": \"alice\", \"status\": \"open\"},\n    {\"id\": 6, \"title\": \"Update help\", \"owner\": \"carol\", \"status\": \"closed\"},\n    {\"id\": 3, \"title\": \"Fix export\", \"owner\": \"alice\", \"status\": \"closed\"},\n    {\"id\": 5, \"title\": \"Slow search\", \"owner\": \"alice\", \"status\": \"in_progress\"},\n    {\"id\": 2, \"title\": \"Add metrics\", \"owner\": \"bob\", \"status\": \"in_progress\"},\n]\n\n\ndef list_tickets(owner=None):\n    \"\"\"Return tickets in ascending id order, optionally matching an exact owner.\"\"\"\n    return sorted(\n        [dict(ticket) for ticket in TICKETS if owner is None or ticket[\"owner\"] == owner],\n        key=lambda ticket: ticket[\"id\"],\n    )\n\n\ndef main():\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=\"Query tickets\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--owner\", help=\"Filter by exact owner\")\n    args = parser.parse_args()\n    print(json.dumps(list_tickets(owner=args.owner), ensure_ascii=False))\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n",

      "content": "\"\"\"BASE-001/BASE-002: immutable pre-existing behavior acceptance tests.\"\"\"\nimport json\n\n\ndef ids(result):\n    assert result.returncode == 0, result.stderr\n    assert result.stderr == \"\"\n    return [ticket[\"id\"] for ticket in json.loads(result.stdout)]\n\n\ndef test_list_all_stable_order(run_cli):\n    assert ids(run_cli()) == [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]\n\n\ndef test_list_preserves_data_fields(run_cli):\n    result = run_cli()\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert json.loads(result.stdout)[0] == {\n        \"id\": 1, \"title\": \"Login error\", \"owner\": \"alice\", \"status\": \"open\"\n    }\n\n\ndef test_owner_alice(run_cli):\n    assert ids(run_cli(\"--owner\", \"alice\")) == [1, 3, 5]\n\n\ndef test_owner_bob(run_cli):\n    assert ids(run_cli(\"--owner\", \"bob\")) == [2, 4]\n\n\ndef test_unknown_owner(run_cli):\n    assert ids(run_cli(\"--owner\", \"nobody\")) == []\n\n\ndef test_owner_case_sensitive(run_cli):\n    assert ids(run_cli(\"--owner\", \"ALICE\")) == []\n\n\ndef test_empty_owner(run_cli):\n    assert ids(run_cli(\"--owner\", \"\")) == []\n\n\ndef test_function_sorting_and_owner(ticket_module):\n    assert [item[\"id\"] for item in ticket_module.list_tickets()] == [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]\n    assert [item[\"id\"] for item in ticket_module.list_tickets(owner=\"alice\")] == [1, 3, 5]\n\n\ndef test_repeated_calls_do_not_mutate_results(ticket_module):\n    before = ticket_module.list_tickets()\n    ticket_module.list_tickets(owner=\"bob\")\n    assert ticket_module.list_tickets() == before\n",

      "content": "\"\"\"Initial ticket query tool: listing and owner filtering only.\"\"\"\nimport argparse\nimport json\n\n\nTICKETS = [\n    {\"id\": 4, \"title\": \"Broken link\", \"owner\": \"bob\", \"status\": \"open\"},\n    {\"id\": 1, \"title\": \"Login error\", \"owner\": \"alice\", \"status\": \"open\"},\n    {\"id\": 6, \"title\": \"Update help\", \"owner\": \"carol\", \"status\": \"closed\"},\n    {\"id\": 3, \"title\": \"Fix export\", \"owner\": \"alice\", \"status\": \"closed\"},\n    {\"id\": 5, \"title\": \"Slow search\", \"owner\": \"alice\", \"status\": \"in_progress\"},\n    {\"id\": 2, \"title\": \"Add metrics\", \"owner\": \"bob\", \"status\": \"in_progress\"},\n]\n\n\ndef list_tickets(owner=None):\n    \"\"\"Return tickets in ascending id order, optionally matching an exact owner.\"\"\"\n    return sorted(\n        [dict(ticket) for ticket in TICKETS if owner is None or ticket[\"owner\"] == owner],\n        key=lambda ticket: ticket[\"id\"],\n    )\n\n\ndef main():\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=\"Query tickets\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--owner\", help=\"Filter by exact owner\")\n    args = parser.parse_args()\n    print(json.dumps(list_tickets(owner=args.owner), ensure_ascii=False))\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n",
